campaign_logline: A desperate pilot navigates a crumbling economic web between three warring factions.
campaign_pitch: Trade routes are collapsing under heavy tariffs. You must navigate the greed of Zenith, the pride of Aurelia, and the grit of Vanguard.
campaign_story_summary: The core systems are starving for resources. Zenith demands more, while Aurelia seeks dominance. Vanguard fights to keep their people alive. You find profit in the chaos between them.

opening.status_quo: Trade routes are collapsing under heavy tariffs.
opening.visible_crisis: Resource scarcity is causing local price spikes.
opening.hidden_crisis: A massive logistics chain collapse has crippled the inner core.
opening.why_now: The current supply cycle just ended, leaving ports empty.
opening.player_role: You are a broke independent pilot.

mystery.question: Why is the trade network failing?
mystery.false_answer: Corrupt officials are hoarding supplies for themselves.
mystery.true_answer_hint: The core routes have been physically blocked by orbital debris.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: The blockage was caused by a deliberate sabotage.

kaelen.secret_angle: She monitors the logistics network's integrity.
kaelen.address_rule: Refer to her as a fixer or broker.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Never mention her knowledge of orbital mechanics.

factions.zenith_problem: They are desperate for luxury components.
factions.aurelia_problem: They want to secure the mining rights.
factions.conflict_triangle: All three factions fight over the same shrinking pool of resources.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Pirates are moving into the gaps left by trade ships.

act_1.name: The Scarcity Gap
act_1.goal: Secure enough supply lines to earn a living.
act_1.opening_incident: A high-value shipment is intercepted and lost.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You find the cargo in a pirate hideout.
act_1.finale: You deliver the haul to a neutral station.
act_1.player_takeaway: Survival depends on finding hidden routes.

starter_mission.title: The Outbound Haul
starter_mission.reason: A transport ship was intercepted by a pirate.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: It is hunting for abandoned cargo.
starter_mission.aftershock: You find the wreckage of the original shipment.

recurring_lue.name: The Ghost Route
recurring_lue.signal: A faint, rhythmic pulse in navigation data.
recurring_lue.first_appearance: It appears on your HUD during a jump.
recurring_lue.escalation: The signal repeats near high-value trade routes.
recurring_lue.payoff_hint: The signal leads to a hidden supply depot.

rumor_trail.name: The Smuggler's Path
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Whispers of a secret route to the core.
clue_templates: An old map shows a hidden gate.
rumor_trail.payoff: Access to a high-value trade route.

horizon.gate_tease: The gates lead further into the unknown.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: New systems appear as you reach the edge.
horizon.future_faction_te_ease: Rumors of a distant, desperate colony exist.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: Rare minerals are found in unstable zones.

regeneration_trigger.description: New arcs appear when the current arc ends.

rules.fallback_rule: If a quest fails, offer an alternative path.

story_questions_for__future_generation: What is the source of the orbital debris?
Why are the factions fighting over resources?
How did the smuggling routes become so valuable?
Who owns the remaining high-value cargo?
Where is the nearest stable trade route?
